limitations: Family world positions and robot states vary;this does not establish duplicate complete inputs or a train/test leak.
The stored contact logger records ball-pin/robot contacts only;no complete pin-pin graph is available. Other-pin movement does not by itself identify its contact cause.
One relative layout and a fixed first-pin target do not test generalization to unseen pin arrangements or contact combinations.
Scope is the deliberately rolling paired_response train/validation packs,not every original Bowling episode or other project tasks.
The1nm value is an audit comparison tolerance only;stored points and model inputs are never rounded.
